_meta.note: Protocol state machines and message sequence flows

flows.name: Standard Connection (TDS 7.x with encryption)
flows.description: Normal TDS 7.x connection flow with TLS encryption negotiated via PRELOGIN
notes: TLS handshake uses PRELOGIN packet type (0x12)
After TLS handshake, all data encrypted including LOGIN7

flows.name: TDS 8.0 Connection
flows.description: TDS 8.0 establishes TLS BEFORE PRELOGIN. TLS is at the transport layer, not inside TDS packets.
notes: TDS 8.0: TLS MUST be established before PRELOGIN
ENCRYPT_CLIENT_CERT bit (0x80; 0x80/0x81/0x83 with OFF/ON/REQ) used in PRELOGIN for certificate-based auth

flows.name: SPNEGO Authentication (TDS 7.x)
flows.description: Integrated Windows authentication using SPNEGO/Kerberos or NTLM

steps.message: LOGIN7 with fIntSecurity=1 (SPNEGO Exchange 1 in SSPI data)
SSPI token (SPNEGO Exchange 1 Response, packet 0x04 with SSPI token 0xED)

flows.name: Federated Authentication (TDS 7.x)
flows.description: Azure AD / federated auth flow where client library needs server info to acquire token

steps.message: LOGIN7 with FEDAUTH FeatureExt (bFedAuthLibrary requires server info)

flows.name: SQL Query with Cancellation
flows.description: Query cancelled by client before completion

steps.message: Table Response: partial results + DONE (DONE_ATTN set)

flows.name: RPC (Stored Procedure Call)
flows.description: Execute a stored procedure by name

steps.message: RPC message (packet 0x03): ALL_HEADERS + ProcName + OptionFlags + Parameters

flows.name: Transaction: Begin/Execute/Commit

steps.message: Table Response: ENVCHANGE (type 8, transaction descriptor) + DONE
SQLBatch or RPC (using transaction descriptor in ALL_HEADERS)

notes: Step 3 is not optional for MARS clients: SQLBatch/RPC must include the descriptor returned by ENVCHANGE type 8 in ALL_HEADERS.TransactionDescriptor.
After TM_COMMIT_XACT or TM_ROLLBACK_XACT, the client keeps using the descriptor until the matching ENVCHANGE completion token arrives and clears it.
ENVCHANGE type 17 (Transaction Ended) also clears the current descriptor and should be treated the same as commit/rollback completion for connection state.

states: Sent Initial TLS Negotiation Packet State (TDS 8.0 only)
Sent TLS/SSL Negotiation Packet State (TDS 7.x only)
Sent LOGIN7 Record with Complete Authentication Token State
Sent LOGIN7 Record with SPNEGO Packet State
Sent LOGIN7 Record with Federated Authentication Information Request State

client_timers.Connection Timer: Default 15 seconds; controls maximum time for TDS connection establishment
client_timers.Client Request Timer: Implementation-dependent default; controls maximum time waiting for server response to a query
client_timers.Cancel Timer: Implementation-dependent default; controls maximum time waiting for cancel acknowledgement after ATTENTION

states.name: Initial State
states.desc: Server has accepted TCP connection; awaiting PRELOGIN (TDS 7.x) or TLS negotiation (TDS 8.0)

states.name: TLS/SSL Negotiation State
states.desc: Server exchanging TLS handshake messages inside PRELOGIN packets (packet type 0x12)

states.name: TLS Negotiation State
states.desc: Server performing TLS handshake at TCP level before any TDS packets

states.name: PRELOGIN Ready State
states.desc: TLS established; server awaiting PRELOGIN packet

states.name: Pre-Login State
states.desc: Server has sent PRELOGIN response; awaiting LOGIN7 or TLS exchange

states.name: Login Ready State
states.desc: Server has completed PRELOGIN exchange; awaiting LOGIN7 packet

states.name: SPNEGO Negotiation State
states.desc: Server processing Windows Integrated Authentication (Kerberos/NTLM); exchanging SSPI tokens

states.name: Federated Authentication Ready State
states.desc: Server has sent FEDAUTHINFO token; awaiting Federated Auth Token message (packet 0x08)

states.name: Logged In State
states.desc: Authentication complete; server awaiting client requests (SQL, RPC, Transaction, Attention, etc.)

states.name: Client Request Execution State
states.desc: Server processing a client request; sending token stream response

states.name: Routing Completed State
states.desc: Server sent LOGINACK + ENVCHANGE(routing) + DONE; client should reconnect to routed server

server_timers.Connection Timer: Controls maximum time for TDS connection establishment
server_timers.Client Request Timer: Controls maximum time allowed for a client request to complete
server_timers.Cancel Timer: Controls maximum time after receiving ATTENTION before sending DONE(DONE_ATTN)
